# Rainout Source

> Free public API and MCP server that tells people whether an outdoor game (softball, baseball, soccer, motocross) will be played. It covers 68 verified venues in TX, OK, LA and FL, and finds teams in public league schedules (City of Austin adult softball, Austin Metro Baseball League) or in a schedule link the user provides. Answers combine official league/venue status, the NWS forecast (with an Open-Meteo fallback) and 10 years of NOAA rain history.

Base URL: https://rainout-agent-source.vercel.app

## For agents

- Rules: confirm the team match with the user; read the one-sentence `reason` aloud with the play odds; official status beats odds; **always ask the user before adding a game to their calendar**. Rainout Source never writes to calendars. It gives you a Google Calendar event body (`calendar_event`, with a stable `iCalUID`) and ICS text.
- If team search returns `next_step: ask_user_for_schedule_url`, ask for the league's schedule link (ICS/webcal feed or schedule page) and search again with `schedule_url`.
- MCP (Streamable HTTP, stateless, read-only): `https://rainout-agent-source.vercel.app/mcp`. Tools: find_team, get_games, check_game, get_venue_status, check_schedule, find_track, get_track_events, check_race, get_track_history, get_rain_chance.
- Motocross: find_track, then confirm the track with the user. For "what are the chances the race at Swan MX on Saturday happens?" call check_race and read `answer`. Events come only from public track and series calendars and are never invented; if none are found (`next_step: ask_user_for_events_url`), ask for the event or series link and pass `events_url`.
- Rain anywhere: get_rain_chance (or `GET /v1/rain`) with a place name or lat/lon gives hourly/daily rain chance and amounts; read `summary`. If `ambiguous` is true, ask which of `matches` the user means.
- OpenAPI (GPT Actions friendly operationIds): https://rainout-agent-source.vercel.app/openapi.yaml

## Endpoints

- [Team search](https://rainout-agent-source.vercel.app/v1/teams/search?q=ATX%20Boys&venue=Craig%20Fields&day=friday): `GET /v1/teams/search?q=&venue=&sport=&day=&schedule_url=` returns candidates with team_id and confidence
- [Team games](https://rainout-agent-source.vercel.app/v1/teams/tsl-340-744621-4306365/games?date=today): `GET /v1/teams/{team_id}/games?date=today|YYYY-MM-DD` or `from=&to=` returns games with play_probability, reason, calendar_event and ics; `next_game` when the range is empty
- `GET /v1/teams/{team_id}/calendar.ics`: subscribable feed with odds in each event
- [Game status](https://rainout-agent-source.vercel.app/v1/status?field_id=Krieg&game_time=2026-10-16T20:20:00-05:00): `GET /v1/status?field_id=&game_time=` for one venue and time
- [Venues](https://rainout-agent-source.vercel.app/v1/fields?state=TX): `GET /v1/fields?sport=&state=`
- `GET|POST /v1/schedule/check`: score a whole schedule (ICS URL, JSON, CSV)
- [Rain chance](https://rainout-agent-source.vercel.app/v1/rain?q=London&hours=12): `GET /v1/rain?q=place|lat=&lon=&hours=&days=&at=&pick=` worldwide hourly/daily rain probability and amounts (NWS in the US, Open-Meteo elsewhere), one-sentence `summary`
- [Motocross tracks](https://rainout-agent-source.vercel.app/v1/tracks): `GET /v1/tracks?q=&state=` lists the 10 supported tracks (TX, FL, OK)
- [Track events](https://rainout-agent-source.vercel.app/v1/tracks/swan/events): `GET /v1/tracks/{track_id}/events?date=|from=&to=&include_practice=&events_url=` returns races with play_probability, reason, official_status, sources, calendar_event and ics
- [Race check](https://rainout-agent-source.vercel.app/v1/tracks/swan/check?date=saturday): `GET /v1/tracks/{track_id}/check?date=|event_id=` returns `answer` (one sentence), the event and next_step
- [Track history](https://rainout-agent-source.vercel.app/v1/tracks/freestone/history): `GET /v1/tracks/{track_id}/history` monthly NOAA rain stats plus documented past rain cancellations with sources and coverage gaps
- `GET /v1/tracks/{track_id}/calendar.ics`: subscribable race feed with odds
